defense_contracts.raw_text: Raytheon, Tucson, Arizona, is being awarded a noncompetitive, multi-year undefinitized contract action on a new contract (HQ0851-27-C-E001). The base value of this contract is $4,432,040,944 with a total value, including options, of $6,342,404,516. Under this contract, the contractor will manufacture and assemble Standard Missile-3 Block IB All-Up-Rounds for the government. The work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona; and Huntsville, Alabama, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 31, 2034. Fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $454,215,132 are being obligated on this award. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity. (Awarded on Oct. 7, 2026).

Aegis Aerospace Inc., Webster, Texas, has been awarded a $9,359,118 modification (P00001) to a previously awarded contract (FA8809-26-F-B003) for transitioning missions from the Department of War human-rated payload support task order. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $34,323,859 from $24,964,741. Work will be performed at Houston, Texas, and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2034. Fiscal 2026 research and development funds in the amount of $654,507 are being obligated at time of award. The Space Systems Command, Kirtland, Air Force Base, Albuquerque, New Mexico, is the contracting activity.

BAE Systems Inc., Rockville, Maryland, is awarded a $99,206,056 hybrid cost-plus-fixed-fee and cost-plus-incentive-fee contract (N0003026C3033) to provide systems engineering and integration support services for Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Strategic Systems Programs (SSP). This contract provides supporting systems engineering, integration, technical information, fleet-support, program-management, cybersecurity, documentation, and related support-service requirements. This award also benefits a Foreign Military Sale. Work will be performed in Rockville, Maryland (61%); Washington, D.C. (20%); Cape Canaveral, Florida (4%); Saint Mary's, Georgia (2%); Silverdale, Washington (1%); Groton, Connecticut (1%); Frederick, Maryland (1%); North Kingstown, Rhode Island (1%); York, Pennsylvania (1%); Huntsville, Alabama (1%); Barrow-in-Furness, United Kingdom (1%); and various other locations under 1% each (6%). Efforts are expected to be completed Sept. 30, 2027. Fiscal 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) funds in the amount of $4,832,638 will be obligated upon award. No funds will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was awarded as a sole-source acquisition pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 2304(c)(1) and was previously synopsized on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) online portal. PAE SSP, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

American Systems Corp., McLean, Virginia, has been awarded a $43,266,824 firm fixed price task order for Red LAN Sustainment. This contract provides for the continued operations and maintenance of the Red Local Area Network (Red LAN) System and Red LAN System Data Provider/Data Recipient additions. Work will be performed at Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado, and is expected to be completed by September 29, 2031. This award is the result of a competitive acquisition and 16 offers were received. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $2,001,232 are being obligated at the time of award. The Space Systems Command, Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado, is the contracting activity (FA8821-26-F-B015).

Vision Quest Solutions Inc., Rapid City, South Dakota, has been awarded a $25,274,553 firm-fixed-price, single award contract for Fire Protection and Emergency Services. This contract provides for the contractor to furnish all labor, tools, materials, equipment, supervision, personnel and all else necessary to manage and accomplish 24-hour 7 days a week fire protection and emergency services. Work will be performed at Cavalier Space Force Station, North Dakota, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 31, 2031. This contract was a competitive 100% small business set aside acquisition and seven offers were received. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance funds in the amount of $5,117,556 will be obligated for the base year. The 319th Contracting Squadron, Grand Forks Air Force Base, North Dakota, is the contracting activity (FA465926C0002).
